|\n|---|---|\n| 2026 年营业收入增速 | +10.0%（以 2025 年经审计营业收入为基数） |\n| 2027—2030 年营业收入增速 | 每年 +10.0% |\n| 预测期毛利率 | 25.0%（各年相同） |\n| 预测期销售费用率+管理费用率+研发费用率合计 | 13.5%（各年相同） |\n| 折旧与摊销占营业收入比例 | 5.0%（各年相同） |\n| 本指引由投资决策委员会核准，收益法测算须严格按本指引参数执行；\n> 参数以外的假设不得自行引入。\n\n## 一、预测期与基准日\n\n1. 估值基准日：**2025 年 12 月 31 日**；\n2. 明确预测期：**2026 年至 2030 年，共 5 个完整会计年度**；\n3. 2030 年之后为永续期。\n\n## 二、经营假设\n\n| 项目 | 假设 |\n|---|---|\n| 2026 年营业收入增速 | +10.0%（以 2025 年经审计营业收入为基数） |\n| 2027—2030 年营业收入增速 | 每年 +10.0% |\n| 预测期毛利率 | 25.0%（各年相同） |\n| 预测期销售费用率+管理费用率+研发费用率合计 | 13.5%（各年相同） |\n| 折旧与摊销占营业收入比例 | 5.0%（各年相同） |\n| 资本性支出占营业收入比例 | 6.0%（各年相同） |\n| 营运资本追加 | 按当年营业收入增量×20.0% |\n| 所得税税率 | 15.0%（高新技术企业，各年相同） |\n\n> 自由现金流口径：FCFF = EBIT×(1−税率) + 折旧与摊销 − 资本性支出 − 营运资本追加；\n> 其中 EBIT = 营业收入 ×(毛利率 − 期间费用率合计)，即营业收入 × 11.5%。\n> 永续期不再单独假设资本性支出与折旧。\n\n## 三、折现率参数\n\n| 参数 | 取值 | 说明 |\n|---|---|---|\n| 无风险利率 Rf | 2.35% | 10 年期国债到期收益率近一年均值 |\n| 市场风险溢价 ERP | 6.00% | 委员会核定，**不得另加规模溢价或其他调整** |\n| 可比公司 Unlevered Beta 中位数 βu | 0.95 | 取自筛选后可比公司样本 |\n| 目标资本结构 D/(D+E) | 20.0% | 即 D/E = 25.0% |\n| 债务成本 Kd（税前） | 4.50% | 参考公司现有借款加权平均成本 |\n| 所得税税率 t | 15.0% | 同经营假设 |\n\n杠杆化公式：**βL = βu × [1 + (1 − t) × D/E]**\n股权成本：**Ke = Rf + βL × ERP**\n加权平均资本成本：**WACC = Ke × E/(D+E) + Kd × (1 − t) × D/(D+E)**\n\n## 四、终值\n\n永续增长率 g = **2.5%**。\n终值 TV = FCFF₂₀₃₀ ×(1 + g) ÷ (WACC − g)。\n\n## 五、企业价值到股权价值\n\n1. EV = Σ[FCFF_t ÷ (1 + WACC)^t] + TV ÷ (1 + WACC)^5（t = 1…5 对应 2026—2030 年）；\n2. **净负债 = 有息负债合计 − 可自由支配的货币资金**（须扣除使用受限的货币资金）；\n3. 股权价值 = EV − 净负债；\n4. 每股价值 = 股权价值 ÷ 总股本（12,000 万股）。\n\n## 六、敏感性分析\n\n对 WACC（±1.0 个百分点）与永续增长率（±0.5 个百分点）做双向敏感性分析，\n输出股权价值矩阵，单位万元。","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false}}

str(s).replace(\"**\", \"\").replace(\",\", \"\").replace(\"，\", \",\")\n    m = re.search(r\"-?\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?\", s)\n    return float(m.group()) if m else None\n\ndef md_tables(text):\n    tables, lines, i = [], text.splitlines(), 0\n    while i < len(lines):\n        if lines[i].lstrip().startswith(\"|\"):\n            blk = []\n            while i < len(lines) and lines[i].lstrip().startswith(\"|\"):\n                blk.append(lines[i].strip()); i += 1\n            if len(blk) >= 2:\n                split = lambda r: [c.strip() for c in r.strip().strip(\"|\").split(\"|\")]\n                headers, rows = split(blk[0]), [split(r) for r in blk[2:]]\n                tables.append((headers, rows))\n        else: i += 1\n    return tables\n\ndef find_table(tables, *labels):\n    for h, rows in tables:\n        flat = \" \".join(h) + \" \" + \" \".join(\" \".join(r) for r in rows)\n        if all(lb in flat for lb in labels): return h, rows\n    return None, None\n\ndef row_by_label(rows, key, col=1):\n    for r in rows:\n        if r and key in r[0].replace(\"**\",\"\").replace(\" \",\"\"):\n            if len(r) > col: return r[col]\n    return None\n```\n\nNote: row_by_label matching: label cell, e.g., \"Operating Cost (including taxes and surcharges)\" — key match uses `in` on cleaned cell. NONREC[p]                       # 扣非归母净利润\n    ebitda_kf = kf + TAX_EXP[p] + INT_EXP[p] + DA[p]\n    adj_ebitda = ebitda_kf + SBC[p]\n    BRIDGE[p] = {\"净利润\": NP_[p], \"非经常性损益(税后)\": NONREC[p], \"扣非归母\": kf,\n                 \"所得税\": TAX_EXP[p], \"利息费用\": INT_EXP[p], \"折旧摊销\": DA[p],\n                 \"EBITDA(扣非口径)\": ebitda_kf, \"股份支付\": SBC[p], \"调整后EBITDA\": adj_ebitda}\n# 市场法用 EBITDA（归母口径，与可比公司“归母净利润→PE”同构）\nEBITDA_2025_PARENT = NP_ATTR[\"2025\"] + TAX_EXP[\"2025\"] + INT_EXP[\"2025\"] + DA[\"2025\"]\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 9. DCF 计算（严格按指引32）\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\ndef run_dcf(wacc, g, beta=None, ret_detail=False):\n    \"\"\"按指引公式计算 DCF；beta 仅用于冲突影响量化披露。\"\"\"\n    if beta is None:\n        bu = BU_GUIDE\n    else:\n        bu = beta\n    bl = bu * (1 + (1 - TAX) * (DDE / (1 - DDE)))\n    ke = RF + bl * ERP\n    w = ke * (1 - DDE) + KD * (1 - TAX) * DDE\n    if wacc is None:\n        wacc = w\n    rev0 = REV[\"2025\"]\n    rows_, prev_rev, pv_sum = [], rev0, 0.0\n    for i, yr in enumerate(FC_YEARS, start=1):\n        g_i = G26 if i == 1 else G2730\n        rev = prev_rev * (1 + g_i)\n        ebit = rev * EBIT_MARGIN\n        da_ = rev * DA_RATIO\n        capex = rev * CAPEX_RATIO\n        dwc = (rev - prev_rev) * DWC_RATIO\n        fcff = ebit * (1 - TAX) + da_ - capex - dwc\n        df = 1 / (1 + wacc) ** i\n        pv_sum += fcff * df\n        rows_.append({\"年份\": yr, \"营业收入\": rev, \"EBIT\": ebit, \"EBIT×(1−t)\": ebit * (1 - TAX),\n                      \"折旧摊销\": da_, \"资本性支出\": capex, \"营运资本追加\": dwc,\n                      \"FCFF\": fcff, \"折现系数\": df, \"现值\": fcff * df})\n        prev_rev = rev\n    tv = rows_[-1][\"FCFF\"] * (1 + g) / (wacc - g)\n    pv_tv = tv / (1 + wacc) ** len(FC_YEARS)\n    ev = pv_sum + pv_tv\n    free_cash = CASH[\"2025\"] - RESTRICTED_CASH[\"2025\"]\n    net_debt = INTEREST_BEARING_DEBT[\"2025\"] - free_cash\n    eq = ev - net_debt\n    out = {\"βu\": bu, \"βL\": bl, \"Ke\": ke, \"WACC\": wacc, \"行\": rows_, \"终值\": tv,\n           \"终值现值\": pv_tv, \"预测期现值合计\": pv_sum, \"EV\": ev,\n           \"可支配货币资金\": free_cash, \"净负债\": net_debt, \"股权价值\": eq,\n           \"每股价值\": eq / TOTAL_SHARES}\n    return out\n\nDCF = run_dcf(None, G_PERP)\nWACC, EQ_DCF = DCF[\"WACC\"], DCF[\"股权价值\"]\n# 敏感性矩阵：WACC ±1.0pp × g ±0.5pp（指引第六节）\nSENS_W = [WACC - 0.01, WACC, WACC + 0.01]\nSENS_G = [G_PERP - 0.005, G_PERP, G_PERP + 0.005]\nSENS = [[run_dcf(w, g)[\"股权价值\"] for g in SENS_G] for w in SENS_W]\n# βu 冲突影响量化（仅披露用）：按文件28样本重算中位数\nDCF_BETA_CHK = run_dcf(None, G_PERP, beta=BETA_MED_CALC)\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 10. 市场法估值（按31号说明）\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\nNET_DEBT_MKT = INTEREST_BEARING_DEBT[\"2025\"] - (CASH[\"2025\"] - RESTRICTED_CASH[\"2025\"])\nV_PE = PE_MED * NP_ATTR[\"2025\"] * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\nV_PS = PS_MED * REV[\"2025\"] * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\nV_EVE = (EVE_MED * EBITDA_2025_PARENT - NET_DEBT_MKT) * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\nMKT_VALS = {\"PE 法\": V_PE, \"PS 法\": V_PS, \"EV/EBITDA 法\": V_EVE}\nMKT_MED = median(list(MKT_VALS.values()))\nMKT_PS_EACH = {\"PE 法\": PE_MED * NP_ATTR[\"2025\"], \"PS 法\": PS_MED * REV[\"2025\"],\n               \"EV/EBITDA 法\": EVE_MED * EBITDA_2025_PARENT - NET_DEBT_MKT}\n# 参考口径：若可比 EBITDA/净利为扣非口径（待核实，仅披露）\nV_PE_KF = PE_MED * BRIDGE[\"2025\"][\"扣非归母\"] * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\nV_EVE_KF = (EVE_MED * BRIDGE[\"2025\"][\"EBITDA(扣非口径)\"] - NET_DEBT_MKT) * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 11. 估值结论与交易方案测算\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\nVAL_LO, VAL_HI = min(MKT_MED, EQ_DCF), max(MKT_MED, EQ_DCF)     # 投资前股权价值区间\nPRE_FLOOR_CAP = INVEST / (STAKE_CAP / 100.0) - INVEST            # 8% 上限对应投前下限\nSTAKE_LO = INVEST / (VAL_HI + INVEST) * 100                      # 区间高端 -> 低持股\nSTAKE_HI = INVEST / (VAL_LO + INVEST) * 100\nPRICE_REC = VAL_LO                                               # 审慎取值：区间下限（市场法中位数）\nPS_REC = PRICE_REC / TOTAL_SHARES                                # 每股价格\nNEW_SHARES = INVEST / PS_REC                                     # 新增股份（万股）\nSTAKE_REC = NEW_SHARES / (TOTAL_SHARES + NEW_SHARES) * 100\nPOST_MONEY_REC = PRICE_REC + INVEST\n# 隐含倍数\nMULT = {\n    \"投前/2025归母\": PRICE_REC / NP_ATTR[\"2025\"],\n    \"投后/2025归母\": POST_MONEY_REC / NP_ATTR[\"2025\"],\n    \"投前/2025扣非归母\": PRICE_REC / BRIDGE[\"2025\"][\"扣非归母\"],\n    \"投后/2025扣非归母\": POST_MONEY_REC / BRIDGE[\"2025\"][\"扣非归母\"],\n    \"投前/2026承诺\": PRICE_REC / COMMIT[\"2026\"],\n    \"投后/2026承诺\": POST_MONEY_REC / COMMIT[\"2026\"],\n    \"投前/2027承诺\": PRICE_REC / COMMIT[\"2027\"],\n    \"投后/2027承诺\": POST_MONEY_REC / COMMIT[\"2027\"],\n    \"投后EV/2025EBITDA\": (POST_MONEY_REC + NET_DEBT_MKT) / EBITDA_2025_PARENT,\n}\n# 业绩承诺覆盖\nCOMMIT_G26_IMPLIED = (COMMIT[\"2026\"] / BRIDGE[\"2025\"][\"扣非归母\"] - 1) * 100\nH1_KF = 退出回报（假设增资于2026年末交割、IPO_YEAR年末上市退出；锁定期材料未载明）\nEXIT_EQ = PE_MED * COMMIT[\"2027\"]                    # 上市口径不加流动性折价（31号：折价因未上市）\nEXIT_MULT = EXIT_EQ / POST_MONEY_REC\nIRR_2Y = EXIT_MULT ** 0.5 - 1\nIRR_3Y = EXIT_MULT ** (1 / 3) - 1\nEXIT_DOWN_EQ = PE_MED * COMMIT[\"2027\"] * (BUYBACK_TRIGGER / 100.0)\nEXIT_DOWN_MULT = EXIT_DOWN_EQ / POST_MONEY_REC\nBUYBACK_AMT = INVEST * (1 + BUYBACK_RATE / 100.0 * 2)\nBUYBACK_MULT = BUYBACK_AMT / INVEST\nEXIT_MULT_DCFPRICE = EXIT_EQ / (VAL_HI + INVEST)\nIRR_2Y_DCFPRICE = EXIT_MULT_DCFPRICE ** 0.5 - 1\n# 期权池摊薄\nPOOL_TOTAL = POOL_UNGRANTED + prev_rev = rev","+    tv = rows_[-1][\"FCFF\"] * (1 + g) / (wacc - g)","+    pv_tv = tv / (1 + wacc) ** len(FC_YEARS)","+    ev = pv_sum + pv_tv","+    free_cash = CASH[\"2025\"] - RESTRICTED_CASH[\"2025\"]","+    net_debt = INTEREST_BEARING_DEBT[\"2025\"] - free_cash","+    eq = ev - net_debt","+    out = {\"βu\": bu, \"βL\": bl, \"Ke\": ke, \"WACC\": wacc, \"行\": rows_, \"终值\": tv,","+           \"终值现值\": pv_tv, \"预测期现值合计\": pv_sum, \"EV\": ev,","+           \"可支配货币资金\": free_cash, \"净负债\": net_debt, \"股权价值\": eq,","+           \"每股价值\": eq / TOTAL_SHARES}","+    return out","+","+DCF = run_dcf(None, G_PERP)","+WACC, EQ_DCF = DCF[\"WACC\"], DCF[\"股权价值\"]","+# 敏感性矩阵：WACC ±1.0pp × g ±0.5pp（指引第六节）","+SENS_W = [WACC - 0.01, WACC, WACC + 0.01]","+SENS_G = [G_PERP - 0.005, G_PERP, G_PERP + 0.005]","+SENS = [[run_dcf(w, g)[\"股权价值\"] for g in SENS_G] for w in SENS_W]","+# βu 冲突影响量化（仅披露用）：按文件28样本重算中位数","+DCF_BETA_CHK = run_dcf(None, G_PERP, \"EV/EBITDA 法\": EVE_MED * EBITDA_2025_PARENT - NET_DEBT_MKT}","+# 参考口径：若可比 EBITDA/净利为扣非口径（待核实，仅披露）","+V_PE_KF = PE_MED * BRIDGE[\"2025\"][\"扣非归母\"] * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)","+V_EVE_KF = (EVE_MED *   ebitda_kf = kf + TAX_EXP[p] + INT_EXP[p] + DA[p]\n    adj_ebitda = ebitda_kf + SBC[p]\n    BRIDGE[p] = {\"净利润\": NP_[p], \"非经常性损益(税后)\": NONREC[p], \"扣非归母\": kf,\n                 \"所得税\": ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 9. DCF 计算（严格按指引32）\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\ndef run_dcf(wacc, g, beta=None, ret_detail=False):\n    \"\"\"按指引公式计算 DCF；beta 仅用于冲突影响量化披露。\"\"\"\n    if beta is None:\n        bu = BU_GUIDE\n    else:\n        bu = beta\n    bl = bu * (1 + (1 - TAX) * (DDE / (1 - DDE)))\n    ke = RF + bl * ERP\n    w = ke * (1 - DDE) + KD * (1 - TAX) * DDE\n    if wacc is None:\n        wacc = w\n    rev0 = REV[\"2025\"]\n    rows_, prev_rev, pv_sum = [], rev0, 0.0\n    for i, yr in enumerate(FC_YEARS, start=1):\n        g_i = G26 if i == 1 else G2730\n        rev = prev_rev * (1 + g_i)\n        ebit = rev * EBIT_MARGIN\n        da_ = rev * DA_RATIO\n        capex = rev * CAPEX_RATIO\n        dwc = (rev - prev_rev) * DWC_RATIO\n        fcff = ebit * (1 - TAX) + da_ - capex - dwc\n        df = 1 / (1 + wacc) ** i\n        pv_sum += fcff * df\n        rows_.append({\"年份\": yr, \"营业收入\": rev, \"EBIT\": ebit, \"EBIT×(1−t)\": ebit * (1 - TAX),\n                      \"折旧摊销\": da_, \"资本性支出\": capex, \"营运资本追加\": dwc,\n                      \"FCFF\": fcff, \"折现系数\": df, \"现值\": fcff * df})\n        prev_rev = rev\n    tv = rows_[-1][\"FCFF\"] * (1 + g) / (wacc - g)\n    pv_tv = tv / (1 + wacc) ** len(FC_YEARS)\n    ev = pv_sum + pv_tv\n    free_cash = CASH[\"2025\"] - RESTRICTED_CASH[\"2025\"]\n    net_debt = INTEREST_BEARING_DEBT[\"2025\"] - free_cash\n    eq = ev - net_debt\n    out = {\"βu\": bu, \"βL\": bl, \"Ke\": ke, \"WACC\": wacc, \"行\": rows_, \"终值\": tv,\n           \"终值现值\": pv_tv, \"预测期现值合计\": pv_sum, \"EV\": ev,\n           \"可支配货币资金\": free_cash, \"净负债\": net_debt, \"股权价值\": eq,\n           \"每股价值\": eq / TOTAL_SHARES}\n    return out\n\nDCF = run_dcf(None, G_PERP)\nWACC, EQ_DCF = DCF[\"WACC\"], DCF[\"股权价值\"]\n# 敏感性矩阵：WACC ±1.0pp × g ±0.5pp（指引第六节）\nSENS_W = [WACC - 0.01, WACC, WACC + 0.01]\nSENS_G = [G_PERP - 0.005, G_PERP, G_PERP + 0.005]\nSENS = [[run_dcf(w, g)[\"股权价值\"] for g in SENS_G] for w in SENS_W]\n# βu 冲突影响量化（仅披露用）：按文件28样本重算中位数\nDCF_BETA_CHK = run_dcf(None, G_PERP, beta=BETA_MED_CALC)\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 10. 市场法估值（按31号说明）\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\nNET_DEBT_MKT = INTEREST_BEARING_DEBT[\"2025\"] - (CASH[\"2025\"] - RESTRICTED_CASH[\"2025\"])\nV_PE = PE_MED * NP_ATTR[\"2025\"] * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\nV_PS = PS_MED * REV[\"2025\"] * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\nV_EVE = (EVE_MED * EBITDA_2025_PARENT - NET_DEBT_MKT) * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\nMKT_VALS = {\"PE 法\": V_PE, \"PS 法\": V_PS, \"EV/EBITDA 法\": V_EVE}\nMKT_MED = median(list(MKT_VALS.values()))\nMKT_PS_EACH = {\"PE 法\": PE_MED * NP_ATTR[\"2025\"], \"PS 法\": PS_MED * REV[\"2025\"],\n               \"EV/EBITDA 法\": EVE_MED * EBITDA_2025_PARENT - NET_DEBT_MKT}\n# 参考口径：若可比 EBITDA/净利为扣非口径（待核实，仅披露）\nV_PE_KF = PE_MED * BRIDGE[\"2025\"][\"扣非归母\"] * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\nV_EVE_KF = (EVE_MED * BRIDGE[\"2025\"][\"EBITDA(扣非口径)\"] - NET_DEBT_MKT) * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 11. 估值结论与交易方案测算\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\nVAL_LO, VAL_HI = min(MKT_MED, EQ_DCF), max(MKT_MED, EQ_DCF)     # 投资前股权价值区间\nPRE_FLOOR_CAP = INVEST / (STAKE_CAP / 100.0) - INVEST            # 8% 上限对应投前下限\nSTAKE_LO = INVEST / (VAL_HI + INVEST) * 100                      # 区间高端 -> 低持股\nSTAKE_HI = INVEST / (VAL_LO + INVEST) * 100\nPRICE_REC = VAL_LO DCF 计算（严格按指引32）\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\ndef run_dcf(wacc, g, beta=None, ret_detail=False):\n    \"\"\"按指引公式计算 DCF；beta 仅用于冲突影响量化披露。\"\"\"\n    if THREE_EXP[p] / REV[p] * 100 for p in PERIODS}\nPER_EXP_R = {p: COST_DETAIL[p][\"期间费用合计\"] / REV[p] * 100 for p in PERIODS}\nRD_R = {p: FS[p][\"研发费用\"] / REV[p] * 100 for p in PERIODS}\nNP_MARGIN = {p: NP_[p] / REV[p] * 100 for p in PERIODS}\nREV_YOY = {\"2024\": (REV[\"2024\"] / REV[\"2023\"] - 1) * 100,\n           \"2025\": (REV[\"2025\"] / REV[\"2024\"] - 1) * 100,\n           \"2026H1年化\": (REV[\"2026H1\"] * 2 / REV[\"2025\"] - 1) * 100}\nOCF_NP = {p: OCF[p] / NP_[p] for p in PERIODS}\nDAYS = 365.0\nAR_DAYS = {p: AR_NET[p] * DAYS / (REV[p] * (2 if p == \"2026H1\" else 1)) for p in PERIODS}\nINV_DAYS = {p: INV_NET[p] * DAYS / (COGS[p] * (2 if p == \"2026H1\" else 1)) for p in PERIODS}\nm = re.search(r\"增值税\\s*\\|\\s*(\\d+)\\s*%\", txt38)\nVAT = float(m.group(1)) / 100 if m else None\nCASH_COLLECT = BANK_2025.get(\"销售商品、提供劳务收到的现金\", 0) / (REV[\"2025\"] * (1 + VAT))\n\n# 利润口径还原桥（逐期）\nBRIDGE = {}\nfor p in PERIODS:\n    kf = NP_[p] - NONREC[p]                       # 扣非归母净利润\n    ebitda_kf = kf + TAX_EXP[p] + INT_EXP[p] + DA[p]\n    adj_ebitda = ebitda_kf + SBC[p]\n    BRIDGE[p] = {\"净利润\": NP_[p], \"非经常性损益(税后)\": NONREC[p], \"扣非归母\": kf,\n                 \"所得税\": TAX_EXP[p], \"利息费用\": INT_EXP[p], \"折旧摊销\": DA[p],\n                 \"EBITDA(扣非口径)\": ebitda_kf, \"股份支付\": SBC[p], \"调整后EBITDA\": adj_ebitda}\n# 市场法用 EBITDA（归母口径，与可比公司“归母净利润→PE”同构）\nEBITDA_2025_PARENT = NP_ATTR[\"2025\"] + TAX_EXP[\"2025\"] + INT_EXP[\"2025\"] + DA[\"2025\"]\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 9. DCF 计算（严格按指引32）\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\ndef run_dcf(wacc, g, beta=None, ret_detail=False):\n    \"\"\"按指引公式计算 DCF；beta 仅用于冲突影响量化披露。\"\"\"\n    if beta is None:\n        bu = BU_GUIDE\n    else:\n        bu = beta\n    bl = bu * (1 + (1 - TAX) * (DDE / (1 - DDE)))\n    ke = RF + bl * ERP\n    w = ke * (1 - DDE) + KD * (1 - TAX) * DDE\n    if wacc is None:\n        wacc = w\n    rev0 = REV[\"2025\"]\n    rows_, prev_rev, pv_sum = [], rev0, 0.0\n    for i, yr in enumerate(FC_YEARS, start=1):\n        g_i = G26 if i == 1 else G2730\n        rev = prev_rev * (1 + g_i)\n        ebit = rev * EBIT_MARGIN\n        da_ = rev * DA_RATIO\n        capex = rev * CAPEX_RATIO\n        dwc = (rev - prev_rev) * DWC_RATIO\n        fcff = ebit * (1 - TAX) + da_ - capex - dwc\n        df = 1 / (1 + wacc) ** i\n        pv_sum += fcff * df\n        rows_.append({\"年份\": yr, \"营业收入\": rev, \"EBIT\": ebit, \"EBIT×(1−t)\": ebit * (1 - TAX),\n                      \"折旧摊销\": da_, \"资本性支出\": capex, \"营运资本追加\": dwc,\n                      \"FCFF\": fcff, \"折现系数\": df, \"现值\": fcff * df})\n        prev_rev = rev\n    tv = rows_[-1][\"FCFF\"] * (1 + g) / (wacc - g)\n    pv_tv = tv / (1 + wacc) ** len(FC_YEARS)\n    ev = pv_sum + pv_tv\n    free_cash = CASH[\"2025\"] - RESTRICTED_CASH[\"2025\"]\n    net_debt = INTEREST_BEARING_DEBT[\"2025\"] - free_cash\n    eq = ev - net_debt\n    out = {\"βu\": bu, \"βL\": bl, \"Ke\": ke, \"WACC\": wacc, \"行\": rows_, \"终值\": tv,\n           \"终值现值\": pv_tv, \"预测期现值合计\": pv_sum, \"EV\": ev,\n           \"可支配货币资金\": free_cash, \"净负债\": net_debt, \"股权价值\": eq,\n           \"每股价值\": eq / TOTAL_SHARES}\n    return out\n\nDCF = run_dcf(None, G_PERP)\nWACC, EQ_DCF = DCF[\"WACC\"], DCF[\"股权价值\"]\n# 敏感性矩阵：WACC ±1.0pp × g ±0.5pp（指引第六节）\nSENS_W = [WACC - 0.01, WACC, WACC + 0.01]\nSENS_G = [G_PERP - 0.005, G_PERP, G_PERP + 0.005]\nSENS = [[run_dcf(w, g)[\"股权价值\"] for g in SENS_G] for w in SENS_W]\n# βu 冲突影响量化（仅披露用）：按文件28样本重算中位数\nDCF_BETA_CHK = run_dcf(None, G_PERP, beta=BETA_MED_CALC)\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 10. 市场法估值（按31号说明）\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\nNET_DEBT_MKT = INTEREST_BEARING_DEBT[\"2025\"] - (CASH[\"2025\"] - RESTRICTED_CASH[\"2025\"])\nV_PE = PE_MED * NP_ATTR[\"2025\"] * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\nV_PS = PS_MED * REV[\"2025\"] * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\nV_EVE = (EVE_MED * EBITDA_2025_PARENT - NET_DEBT_MKT) * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\nMKT_VALS = {\"PE 法\": V_PE, \"PS 法\": V_PS, \"EV/EBITDA 法\": V_EVE}\nMKT_MED = median(list(MKT_VALS.values()))\nMKT_PS_EACH = {\"PE 法\": PE_MED * NP_ATTR[\"2025\"], \"PS 法\": PS_MED * REV[\"2025\"],\n               \"EV/EBITDA 法\": EVE_MED * EBITDA_2025_PARENT - NET_DEBT_MKT}\n# 参考口径：若可比 EBITDA/净利为扣非口径（待核实，仅披露）\nV_PE_KF = PE_MED * BRIDGE[\"2025\"][\"扣非归母\"] * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\nV_EVE_KF = (EVE_MED * BRIDGE[\"2025\"][\"EBITDA(扣非口径)\"] - NET_DEBT_MKT) * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 11. 估值结论与交易方案测算\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\nVAL_LO, VAL_HI = min(MKT_MED, EQ_DCF), max(MKT_MED, EQ_DCF)     # 投资前股权价值区间\nPRE_FLOOR_CAP = INVEST / (STAKE_CAP / 100.0) - DCF 计算（严格按指引32）\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\ndef run_dcf(wacc, g, beta=None, ret_detail=False):\n    \"\"\"按指引公式计算 DCF；beta 仅用于冲突影响量化披露。\"\"\"\n    if ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 9. DCF 计算（严格按指引32）\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\ndef run_dcf(wacc, g, beta=None, ret_detail=False):\n    \"\"\"按指引公式计算 DCF；beta 仅用于冲突影响量化披露。\"\"\"\n    if beta is None:\n        bu = BU_GUIDE\n    else:\n        bu = beta\n    bl = bu * (1 + (1 - TAX) * (DDE / (1 - DDE)))\n    ke = RF + bl * ERP\n    w = ke * (1 - DDE) + KD * (1 - TAX) * DDE\n    if wacc is None:\n        wacc = w\n    rev0 = REV[\"2025\"]\n    rows_, prev_rev, pv_sum = [], rev0, 0.0\n    for i, yr in enumerate(FC_YEARS, start=1):\n        g_i = G26 if i == 1 else G2730\n        rev = prev_rev * (1 + g_i)\n        ebit = rev * EBIT_MARGIN\n        da_ = rev * DA_RATIO\n        capex = rev * CAPEX_RATIO\n        dwc = (rev - prev_rev) * DWC_RATIO\n        fcff = ebit * (1 - TAX) + da_ - capex - dwc\n        df = 1 / (1 + wacc) ** i\n        pv_sum += fcff * df\n        rows_.append({\"年份\": yr, \"营业收入\": rev, \"EBIT\": ebit, \"EBIT×(1−t)\": ebit * (1 - TAX),\n                      \"折旧摊销\": da_, \"资本性支出\": capex, \"营运资本追加\": dwc,\n                      \"FCFF\": fcff, \"折现系数\": df, \"现值\": fcff * df})\n        prev_rev = rev\n    tv = rows_[-1][\"FCFF\"] * (1 + g) / (wacc - g)\n    pv_tv = tv / (1 + wacc) ** len(FC_YEARS)\n    ev = pv_sum + pv_tv\n    free_cash = CASH[\"2025\"] - RESTRICTED_CASH[\"2025\"]\n    net_debt = INTEREST_BEARING_DEBT[\"2025\"] - free_cash\n    eq = ev - net_debt\n    out = {\"βu\": bu, \"βL\": bl, \"Ke\": ke, \"WACC\": wacc, \"行\": rows_, \"终值\": tv,\n           \"终值现值\": pv_tv, \"预测期现值合计\": pv_sum, \"EV\": ev,\n           \"可支配货币资金\": free_cash, \"净负债\": net_debt, \"股权价值\": eq,\n           \"每股价值\": eq / TOTAL_SHARES}\n    return out\n\nDCF = run_dcf(None, G_PERP)\nWACC, EQ_DCF = DCF[\"WACC\"], DCF[\"股权价值\"]\n# 敏感性矩阵：WACC ±1.0pp × g ±0.5pp（指引第六节）\nSENS_W = [WACC - 0.01, WACC, WACC + 0.01]\nSENS_G = [G_PERP - 0.005, G_PERP, G_PERP + 0.005]\nSENS = [[run_dcf(w, g)[\"股权价值\"] for g in SENS_G] for w in SENS_W]\n# βu 冲突影响量化（仅披露用）：按文件28样本重算中位数\nDCF_BETA_CHK = run_dcf(None, G_PERP, beta=BETA_MED_CALC)\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 10. 市场法估值（按31号说明）\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\nNET_DEBT_MKT = INTEREST_BEARING_DEBT[\"2025\"] - (CASH[\"2025\"] - RESTRICTED_CASH[\"2025\"])\nV_PE = PE_MED * NP_ATTR[\"2025\"] * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\nV_PS = PS_MED * REV[\"2025\"] * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\nV_EVE = (EVE_MED * EBITDA_2025_PARENT - NET_DEBT_MKT) * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\nMKT_VALS = {\"PE 法\": V_PE, \"PS 法\": V_PS, \"EV/EBITDA 法\": V_EVE}\nMKT_MED = median(list(MKT_VALS.values()))\nMKT_PS_EACH = {\"PE 法\": PE_MED * NP_ATTR[\"2025\"], \"PS 法\": PS_MED * REV[\"2025\"],\n               \"EV/EBITDA 法\": EVE_MED * EBITDA_2025_PARENT - NET_DEBT_MKT}\n# 参考口径：若可比 EBITDA/净利为扣非口径（待核实，仅披露）\nV_PE_KF = PE_MED * BRIDGE[\"2025\"][\"扣非归母\"] * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\nV_EVE_KF = (EVE_MED * BRIDGE[\"2025\"][\"EBITDA(扣非口径)\"] - NET_DEBT_MKT) * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 11. 估值结论与交易方案测算\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\nVAL_LO, VAL_HI = min(MKT_MED, EQ_DCF), max(MKT_MED, EQ_DCF)     # 投资前股权价值区间\nPRE_FLOOR_CAP = INVEST / (STAKE_CAP / 100.0) -                       # 审慎取值：区间下限（市场法中位数）\nPS_REC = PRICE_REC / TOTAL_SHARES                                # 每股价格\nNEW_SHARES = INVEST / PS_REC                                     # DCF 计算（严格按指引32）\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\ndef run_dcf(wacc, g, beta=None, ret_detail=False):\n    \"\"\"按指引公式计算 DCF；beta 仅用于冲突影响量化披露。\"\"\"\n    if   ebitda_kf = kf + TAX_EXP[p] + INT_EXP[p] + DA[p]\n    adj_ebitda = ebitda_kf + SBC[p]\n    BRIDGE[p] = {\"净利润\": NP_[p], \"非经常性损益(税后)\": NONREC[p], \"扣非归母\": kf,\n                 \"所得税\": EBITDA（归母口径，与可比公司“归母净利润→PE”同构）\nEBITDA_2025_PARENT = NP_ATTR[\"2025\"] + TAX_EXP[\"2025\"] + INT_EXP[\"2025\"] + DA[\"2025\"]\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 9. DCF 计算（严格按指引32）\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\ndef run_dcf(wacc, g, beta=None, ret_detail=False):\n    \"\"\"按指引公式计算 DCF；beta 仅用于冲突影响量化披露。\"\"\"\n    if beta is None:\n        bu = BU_GUIDE\n    else:\n        bu = beta\n    bl = bu * (1 + (1 - TAX) * (DDE / (1 - DDE)))\n    ke = RF + bl * ERP\n    w = ke * (1 - DDE) + KD * (1 - TAX) * DDE\n    if wacc is None:\n        wacc = w\n    rev0 = REV[\"2025\"]\n    rows_, prev_rev, pv_sum = [], rev0, 0.0\n    for i, yr in enumerate(FC_YEARS, start=1):\n        g_i = G26 if i == 1 else G2730\n        rev = prev_rev * (1 + g_i)\n        ebit = rev * EBIT_MARGIN\n        da_ = rev * DA_RATIO\n        capex = rev * CAPEX_RATIO\n        dwc = (rev - prev_rev) * DWC_RATIO\n        fcff = ebit * (1 - TAX) + da_ - capex - dwc\n        df = 1 / (1 + wacc) ** i\n        pv_sum += fcff * df\n        rows_.append({\"年份\": yr, \"营业收入\": rev, \"EBIT\": ebit, \"EBIT×(1−t)\": ebit * (1 - TAX),\n                      \"折旧摊销\": da_, \"资本性支出\": capex, \"营运资本追加\": dwc,\n                      \"FCFF\": fcff, \"折现系数\": df, \"现值\": fcff * df})\n        prev_rev = rev\n    tv = rows_[-1][\"FCFF\"] * (1 + g) / (wacc - g)\n    pv_tv = tv / (1 + wacc) ** len(FC_YEARS)\n    ev = pv_sum + pv_tv\n    free_cash = CASH[\"2025\"] - RESTRICTED_CASH[\"2025\"]\n    net_debt = INTEREST_BEARING_DEBT[\"2025\"] - free_cash\n    eq = ev - net_debt\n    out = {\"βu\": bu, \"βL\": bl, \"Ke\": ke, \"WACC\": wacc, \"行\": rows_, \"终值\": tv,\n           \"终值现值\": pv_tv, \"预测期现值合计\": pv_sum, \"EV\": ev,\n           \"可支配货币资金\": free_cash, \"净负债\": net_debt, \"股权价值\": eq,\n           \"每股价值\": eq / TOTAL_SHARES}\n    return out\n\nDCF = run_dcf(None, G_PERP)\nWACC, EQ_DCF = DCF[\"WACC\"], DCF[\"股权价值\"]\n# 敏感性矩阵：WACC ±1.0pp × g ±0.5pp（指引第六节）\nSENS_W = [WACC - 0.01, WACC, WACC + 0.01]\nSENS_G = [G_PERP - 0.005, G_PERP, G_PERP + 0.005]\nSENS = [[run_dcf(w, g)[\"股权价值\"] for g in SENS_G] for w in SENS_W]\n# βu 冲突影响量化（仅披露用）：按文件28样本重算中位数\nDCF_BETA_CHK = run_dcf(None, G_PERP, beta=BETA_MED_CALC)\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 10. 市场法估值（按31号说明）\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\nNET_DEBT_MKT = INTEREST_BEARING_DEBT[\"2025\"] - (CASH[\"2025\"] - RESTRICTED_CASH[\"2025\"])\nV_PE = PE_MED * NP_ATTR[\"2025\"] * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\nV_PS = PS_MED * REV[\"2025\"] * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\nV_EVE = (EVE_MED * EBITDA_2025_PARENT - NET_DEBT_MKT) * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\nMKT_VALS = {\"PE 法\": V_PE, \"PS 法\": V_PS, \"EV/EBITDA 法\": V_EVE}\nMKT_MED = median(list(MKT_VALS.values()))\nMKT_PS_EACH = {\"PE 法\": PE_MED * NP_ATTR[\"2025\"], \"PS 法\": PS_MED * REV[\"2025\"],\n               \"EV/EBITDA 法\": EVE_MED * EBITDA_2025_PARENT - NET_DEBT_MKT}\n# 参考口径：若可比 EBITDA/净利为扣非口径（待核实，仅披露）\nV_PE_KF = PE_MED * BRIDGE[\"2025\"][\"扣非归母\"] * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\nV_EVE_KF = (EVE_MED * BRIDGE[\"2025\"][\"EBITDA(扣非口径)\"] - NET_DEBT_MKT) * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 11. 估值结论与交易方案测算\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\nVAL_LO, VAL_HI = min(MKT_MED, EQ_DCF), max(MKT_MED, EQ_DCF)     # 投资前股权价值区间\nPRE_FLOOR_CAP = INVEST / (STAKE_CAP / 100.0) - INVEST            # 8% 上限对应投前下限\nSTAKE_LO = INVEST / (VAL_HI + INVEST) * 100                      # 区间高端 -> 低持股\nSTAKE_HI = INVEST / (VAL_LO + INVEST) * 100\nPRICE_REC = VAL_LO                                               # 审慎取值：区间下限（市场法中位数）\nPS_REC = PRICE_REC / TOTAL_SHARES                                # 每股价格\nNEW_SHARES = INVEST / PS_REC                                     # 新增股份（万股）\nSTAKE_REC = NEW_SHARES / (TOTAL_SHARES + NEW_SHARES) * 100\nPOST_MONEY_REC = PRICE_REC + INVEST\n# 隐含倍数\nMULT = {\n    \"投前/2025归母\": PRICE_REC / NP_ATTR[\"2025\"],\n    \"投后/2025归母\": POST_MONEY_REC / NP_ATTR[\"2025\"],\n    \"投前/2025扣非归母\": PRICE_REC / BRIDGE[\"2025\"][\"扣非归母\"],\n    \"投后/2025扣非归母\": POST_MONEY_REC / BRIDGE[\"2025\"][\"扣非归母\"],\n    \"投前/2026承诺\": PRICE_REC / COMMIT[\"2026\"],\n    \"投后/2026承诺\": POST_MONEY_REC / COMMIT[\"2026\"],\n    \"投前/2027承诺\": PRICE_REC / COMMIT[\"2027\"],\n    \"投后/2027承诺\": POST_MONEY_REC / COMMIT[\"2027\"],\n    \"投后EV/2025EBITDA\": (POST_MONEY_REC + NET_DEBT_MKT) / EBITDA_2025_PARENT,\n}\n# 业绩承诺覆盖\nCOMMIT_G26_IMPLIED = (COMMIT[\"2026\"] / BRIDGE[\"2025\"][\"扣非归母\"] - 1) * 100\nH1_KF = 退出回报（假设增资于2026年末交割、IPO_YEAR年末上市退出；锁定期材料未载明）\nEXIT_EQ = PE_MED * COMMIT[\"2027\"]                    # 上市口径不加流动性折价（31号：折价因未上市）\nEXIT_MULT = EXIT_EQ / POST_MONEY_REC\nIRR_2Y = EXIT_MULT ** 0.5 - 1\nIRR_3Y = EXIT_MULT ** (1 / 3) - 1\nEXIT_DOWN_EQ = PE_MED * COMMIT[\"2027\"] * (BUYBACK_TRIGGER / 100.0)\nEXIT_DOWN_MULT = EXIT_DOWN_EQ / POST_MONEY_REC\nBUYBACK_AMT = INVEST * (1 + BUYBACK_RATE / 100.0 * 2)\nBUYBACK_MULT = BUYBACK_AMT / INVEST\nEXIT_MULT_DCFPRICE = EXIT_EQ / (VAL_HI + INVEST)\nIRR_2Y_DCFPRICE = EXIT_MULT_DCFPRICE ** 0.5 - 1\n# 期权池摊薄\nPOOL_TOTAL = POOL_UNGRANTED + v = first_pct(cell)\n        return v / 100.0 if v is not None else None\n    return num(cell)\n\nG26 = p32(\"2026 年营业收入增速\")\nG2730 = p32(\"2027—2030 年营业收入增速\")\nGM = p32(\"预测期毛利率\")\nOPEX_RATIO = ERP\")\nBU_GUIDE = p32(\"可比公司 Unlevered Beta 中位数\", pct=False)\nDDE = p32(\"目标资本结构 D/(D+E)\")\nKD = p32(\"债务成本 Kd（税前）\")\nm = re.search(r\"永续增长率\\s*g\\s*=\\s*\\*{0,2}(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)\\s*%\", else list(range(2026, 2031))\nEBIT_MARGIN = GM - OPEX_RATIO        # 指引：EBIT = 营业收入 ×(毛利率−期间费用率合计)\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 8. 经营质量指标计算\n# p in PERIODS}\nGM_PROD = {p: sum(PROD_GP[p].values()) / REV[p] * 100 for p in PERIODS}\nTHREE_EXP = {p: FS[p][\"销售费用\"] + FS[p][\"管理费用\"] + FS[p][\"研发费用\"] for p in PERIODS}\nTHREE_EXP_R = {p: ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 9. DCF 计算（严格按指引32）\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\ndef run_dcf(wacc, g, beta=None, ret_detail=False):\n    \"\"\"按指引公式计算 DCF；beta 仅用于冲突影响量化披露。\"\"\"\n    if beta is None:\n        bu = BU_GUIDE\n    else:\n        bu = beta\n    bl = bu * (1 + (1 - TAX) * (DDE / (1 - DDE)))\n    ke = RF + bl * ERP\n    w = ke * (1 - DDE) + KD * (1 - TAX) * DDE\n    if wacc is None:\n        wacc = w\n    rev0 = REV[\"2025\"]\n    rows_, prev_rev, pv_sum = [], rev0, 0.0\n    for i, yr in enumerate(FC_YEARS, start=1):\n        g_i = G26 if i == 1 else G2730\n        rev = prev_rev * (1 + g_i)\n        ebit = rev * EBIT_MARGIN\n        da_ = rev * DA_RATIO\n        capex = rev * CAPEX_RATIO\n        dwc = (rev - prev_rev) * DWC_RATIO\n        fcff = ebit * (1 - TAX) + da_ - capex - dwc\n        df = 1 / (1 + wacc) ** i\n        pv_sum += fcff * df\n        rows_.append({\"年份\": yr, \"营业收入\": rev, \"EBIT\": ebit, \"EBIT×(1−t)\": ebit * (1 - TAX),\n                      \"折旧摊销\": da_, \"资本性支出\": capex, \"营运资本追加\": dwc,\n                      \"FCFF\": fcff, \"折现系数\": df, \"现值\": fcff * df})\n        prev_rev = rev\n    tv = rows_[-1][\"FCFF\"] * (1 + g) / (wacc - g)\n    pv_tv = tv / (1 + wacc) ** len(FC_YEARS)\n    ev = pv_sum + pv_tv\n    free_cash = CASH[\"2025\"] - RESTRICTED_CASH[\"2025\"]\n    net_debt = INTEREST_BEARING_DEBT[\"2025\"] - free_cash\n    eq = ev - net_debt\n    out = {\"βu\": bu, \"βL\": bl, \"Ke\": ke, \"WACC\": wacc, \"行\": rows_, \"终值\": tv,\n           \"终值现值\": pv_tv, \"预测期现值合计\": pv_sum, \"EV\": ev,\n           \"可支配货币资金\": free_cash, \"净负债\": net_debt, \"股权价值\": eq,\n           \"每股价值\": eq / TOTAL_SHARES}\n    return out\n\nDCF = run_dcf(None, G_PERP)\nWACC, EQ_DCF = DCF[\"WACC\"], DCF[\"股权价值\"]\n#   ebitda_kf = kf + TAX_EXP[p] + INT_EXP[p] + DA[p]\n    adj_ebitda = ebitda_kf + SBC[p]\n    BRIDGE[p] = {\"净利润\": NP_[p], \"非经常性损益(税后)\": NONREC[p], \"扣非归母\": kf,\n                 \"所得税\": EBITDA（归母口径，与可比公司“归母净利润→PE”同构）\nEBITDA_2025_PARENT = NP_ATTR[\"2025\"] + TAX_EXP[\"2025\"] + INT_EXP[\"2025\"] + DA[\"2025\"]\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 9. DCF 计算（严格按指引32）\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\ndef run_dcf(wacc, g, beta=None, ret_detail=False):\n    \"\"\"按指引公式计算 DCF；beta 仅用于冲突影响量化披露。\"\"\"\n    if beta is None:\n        bu = BU_GUIDE\n    else:\n        bu = beta\n    bl = bu * (1 + (1 - TAX) * (DDE / (1 - DDE)))\n    ke = RF + bl * ERP\n    w = ke * (1 - DDE) + KD * (1 - TAX) * DDE\n    if wacc is None:\n        wacc = w\n    rev0 = REV[\"2025\"]\n    rows_, prev_rev, pv_sum = [], rev0, 0.0\n    for i, yr in enumerate(FC_YEARS, start=1):\n        g_i = G26 if i == 1 else G2730\n        rev = prev_rev * (1 + g_i)\n        ebit = rev * EBIT_MARGIN\n        da_ = rev * DA_RATIO\n        capex = rev * CAPEX_RATIO\n        dwc = (rev - prev_rev) * DWC_RATIO\n        fcff = ebit * (1 - TAX) + da_ - capex - dwc\n        df = 1 / (1 + wacc) ** i\n        pv_sum += fcff * df\n        rows_.append({\"年份\": yr, \"营业收入\": rev, \"EBIT\": ebit, \"EBIT×(1−t)\": ebit * (1 - TAX),\n                      \"折旧摊销\": da_, \"资本性支出\": capex, \"营运资本追加\": dwc,\n                      \"FCFF\": fcff, \"折现系数\": df, \"现值\": fcff * df})\n        prev_rev = rev\n    tv = rows_[-1][\"FCFF\"] * (1 + g) / (wacc - g)\n    pv_tv = tv / (1 + wacc) ** len(FC_YEARS)\n    ev = pv_sum + pv_tv\n    free_cash = CASH[\"2025\"] - RESTRICTED_CASH[\"2025\"]\n    net_debt = INTEREST_BEARING_DEBT[\"2025\"] - free_cash\n    eq = ev - net_debt\n    out = {\"βu\": bu, \"βL\": bl, \"Ke\": ke, \"WACC\": wacc, \"行\": rows_, \"终值\": tv,\n           \"终值现值\": pv_tv, \"预测期现值合计\": pv_sum, \"EV\": ev,\n           \"可支配货币资金\": free_cash, \"净负债\": net_debt, \"股权价值\": eq,\n           \"每股价值\": eq / TOTAL_SHARES}\n    return out\n\nDCF = run_dcf(None, G_PERP)\nWACC, EQ_DCF = DCF[\"WACC\"], DCF[\"股权价值\"]\n# 敏感性矩阵：WACC ±1.0pp × g ±0.5pp（指引第六节）\nSENS_W = [WACC - 0.01, WACC, WACC + 0.01]\nSENS_G = [G_PERP - 0.005, G_PERP, G_PERP + 0.005]\nSENS = [[run_dcf(w, g)[\"股权价值\"] for g in SENS_G] for w in SENS_W]\n# βu 冲突影响量化（仅披露用）：按文件28样本重算中位数\nDCF_BETA_CHK = run_dcf(None, G_PERP, beta=BETA_MED_CALC)\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 10. 市场法估值（按31号说明）\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\nNET_DEBT_MKT = INTEREST_BEARING_DEBT[\"2025\"] - (CASH[\"2025\"] - RESTRICTED_CASH[\"2025\"])\nV_PE = PE_MED * NP_ATTR[\"2025\"] * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\nV_PS = PS_MED * REV[\"2025\"] * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\nV_EVE = (EVE_MED * EBITDA_2025_PARENT - NET_DEBT_MKT) * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\nMKT_VALS = {\"PE 法\": V_PE, \"PS 法\": V_PS, \"EV/EBITDA 法\": V_EVE}\nMKT_MED = median(list(MKT_VALS.values()))\nMKT_PS_EACH = {\"PE 法\": PE_MED * NP_ATTR[\"2025\"], \"PS 法\": PS_MED * REV[\"2025\"],\n               \"EV/EBITDA 法\": EVE_MED * EBITDA_2025_PARENT - NET_DEBT_MKT}\n# 参考口径：若可比 EBITDA/净利为扣非口径（待核实，仅披露）\nV_PE_KF = PE_MED * BRIDGE[\"2025\"][\"扣非归母\"] * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\nV_EVE_KF = (EVE_MED * BRIDGE[\"2025\"][\"EBITDA(扣非口径)\"] - NET_DEBT_MKT) * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 11. 估值结论与交易方案测算\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\nVAL_LO, VAL_HI = min(MKT_MED, EQ_DCF), max(MKT_MED, EQ_DCF)     # 投资前股权价值区间\nPRE_FLOOR_CAP = INVEST / (STAKE_CAP / 100.0) - INVEST            # 8% 上限对应投前下限\nSTAKE_LO = INVEST / (VAL_HI + INVEST) * 100                      # 区间高端 -> 低持股\nSTAKE_HI = INVEST / (VAL_LO + INVEST) * 100\nPRICE_REC = VAL_LO                                               # 审慎取值：区间下限（市场法中位数）\nPS_REC = PRICE_REC / TOTAL_SHARES                                # 每股价格\nNEW_SHARES = INVEST / PS_REC                                     # 新增股份（万股）\nSTAKE_REC = NEW_SHARES / (TOTAL_SHARES + NEW_SHARES) * 100\nPOST_MONEY_REC = PRICE_REC + INVEST\n# 隐含倍数\nMULT = {\n    \"投前/2025归母\": PRICE_REC / NP_ATTR[\"2025\"],\n    \"投后/2025归母\": \"投后EV/2025EBITDA\": (POST_MONEY_REC + NET_DEBT_MKT) / EBITDA_2025_PARENT,\n}\n# 业绩承诺覆盖\nCOMMIT_G26_IMPLIED = (COMMIT[\"2026\"] / BRIDGE[\"2025\"][\"扣非归母\"] - 1) * 100\nH1_KF = 退出回报（假设增资于2026年末交割、IPO_YEAR年末上市退出；锁定期材料未载明）\nEXIT_EQ = PE_MED * COMMIT[\"2027\"]                    # 上市口径不加流动性折价（31号：折价因未上市）\nEXIT_MULT = EXIT_EQ / POST_MONEY_REC\nIRR_2Y = EXIT_MULT ** 0.5 - 100.0 * 2)\nBUYBACK_MULT = BUYBACK_AMT / INVEST\nEXIT_MULT_DCFPRICE = EXIT_EQ / (VAL_HI + INVEST)\nIRR_2Y_DCFPRICE = EXIT_MULT_DCFPRICE ** 0.5 - 1\n# 期权池摊薄\nPOOL_TOTAL = POOL_UNGRANTED + None\nCASH_COLLECT = BANK_2025.get(\"销售商品、提供劳务收到的现金\", 0) / (REV[\"2025\"] * (1 + VAT))\n\n# 利润口径还原桥（逐期）\nBRIDGE = {}\nfor p in PERIODS:\n    kf = NP_[p] - NONREC[p]                       # 扣非归母净利润\n    ebitda_kf = kf + TAX_EXP[p] + INT_EXP[p] + DA[p]\n    adj_ebitda = ebitda_kf + SBC[p]\n    BRIDGE[p] = {\"净利润\": NP_[p], \"非经常性损益(税后)\": NONREC[p], \"扣非归母\": kf,\n                 \"所得税\": TAX_EXP[p], \"利息费用\": INT_EXP[p], \"折旧摊销\": DA[p],\n                 \"EBITDA(扣非口径)\": ebitda_kf, \"股份支付\": SBC[p], \"调整后EBITDA\": adj_ebitda}\n# 市场法用 EBITDA（归母口径，与可比公司“归母净利润→PE”同构）\nEBITDA_2025_PARENT = NP_ATTR[\"2025\"] + TAX_EXP[\"2025\"] + INT_EXP[\"2025\"] + DA[\"2025\"]\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 9. DCF 计算（严格按指引32）\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\ndef run_dcf(wacc, g, beta=None, ret_detail=False):\n    \"\"\"按指引公式计算 DCF；beta 仅用于冲突影响量化披露。\"\"\"\n    if beta is None:\n        bu = BU_GUIDE\n    else:\n        bu = beta\n    bl = bu * (1 + (1 - TAX) * (DDE / (1 - DDE)))\n    ke = RF + bl * ERP\n    w = ke * (1 - DDE) + KD * (1 - TAX) * DDE\n    if wacc is None:\n        wacc = w\n    rev0 = REV[\"2025\"]\n    rows_, prev_rev, pv_sum = [], rev0, 0.0\n    for i, yr in enumerate(FC_YEARS, start=1):\n        g_i = G26 if i == 1 else G2730\n        rev = prev_rev * (1 + g_i)\n        ebit = rev * EBIT_MARGIN\n        da_ = rev * DA_RATIO\n        capex = rev * CAPEX_RATIO\n        dwc = (rev - prev_rev) * DWC_RATIO\n        fcff = ebit * (1 - TAX) + da_ - capex - dwc\n        df = 1 / (1 + wacc) ** i\n        pv_sum += fcff * df\n        rows_.append({\"年份\": yr, \"营业收入\": rev, \"EBIT\": ebit, \"EBIT×(1−t)\": ebit * (1 - TAX),\n                      \"折旧摊销\": da_, \"资本性支出\": capex, \"营运资本追加\": dwc,\n                      \"FCFF\": fcff, \"折现系数\": df, \"现值\": fcff * df})\n        prev_rev = rev\n    tv = rows_[-1][\"FCFF\"] * (1 + g) / (wacc - g)\n    pv_tv = tv / (1 + wacc) ** len(FC_YEARS)\n    ev = pv_sum + pv_tv\n    free_cash = CASH[\"2025\"] - RESTRICTED_CASH[\"2025\"]\n    net_debt = INTEREST_BEARING_DEBT[\"2025\"] - free_cash\n    eq = ev - net_debt\n    out = {\"βu\": bu, \"βL\": bl, \"Ke\": ke, \"WACC\": wacc, \"行\": rows_, \"终值\": tv,\n           \"终值现值\": pv_tv, \"预测期现值合计\": pv_sum, \"EV\": ev,\n           \"可支配货币资金\": free_cash, \"净负债\": net_debt, \"股权价值\": eq,\n           \"每股价值\": eq / TOTAL_SHARES}\n    return out\n\nDCF = run_dcf(None, G_PERP)\nWACC, EQ_DCF = DCF[\"WACC\"], DCF[\"股权价值\"]\n# 敏感性矩阵：WACC ±1.0pp × g ±0.5pp（指引第六节）\nSENS_W = [WACC - 0.01, WACC, WACC + 0.01]\nSENS_G = [G_PERP - 0.005, G_PERP, G_PERP + 0.005]\nSENS = [[run_dcf(w, g)[\"股权价值\"] for g in SENS_G] for w in SENS_W]\n# βu 冲突影响量化（仅披露用）：按文件28样本重算中位数\nDCF_BETA_CHK = run_dcf(None, G_PERP, beta=BETA_MED_CALC)\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 10. 市场法估值（按31号说明）\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\nNET_DEBT_MKT = INTEREST_BEARING_DEBT[\"2025\"] - (CASH[\"2025\"] - RESTRICTED_CASH[\"2025\"])\nV_PE = PE_MED * NP_ATTR[\"2025\"] * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\nV_PS = PS_MED * REV[\"2025\"] * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\nV_EVE = (EVE_MED * EBITDA_2025_PARENT - NET_DEBT_MKT) * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\nMKT_VALS = {\"PE 法\": V_PE, \"PS 法\": V_PS, \"EV/EBITDA 法\": V_EVE}\nMKT_MED = median(list(MKT_VALS.values()))\nMKT_PS_EACH = {\"PE 法\": PE_MED * NP_ATTR[\"2025\"], \"PS 法\": PS_MED * REV[\"2025\"],\n               \"EV/EBITDA 法\": EVE_MED * EBITDA_2025_PARENT - NET_DEBT_MKT}\n# 参考口径：若可比 EBITDA/净利为扣非口径（待核实，仅披露）\nV_PE_KF = PE_MED * BRIDGE[\"2025\"][\"扣非归母\"] * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\nV_EVE_KF = (EVE_MED * BRIDGE[\"2025\"][\"EBITDA(扣非口径)\"] - NET_DEBT_MKT) * (1 - LIQ_DISCOUNT)\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 11. 估值结论与交易方案测算\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\nVAL_LO, VAL_HI = min(MKT_MED, EQ_DCF), max(MKT_MED, EQ_DCF)     # 投资前股权价值区间\nPRE_FLOOR_CAP = INVEST / (STAKE_CAP / 100.0) - INVEST            # 8% 上限对应投前下限\nSTAKE_LO = INVEST / (VAL_HI + INVEST) * 100                      # 区间高端 -> 低持股\nSTAKE_HI = INVEST / (VAL_LO + INVEST) * 100\nPRICE_REC = VAL_LO                                               # 审慎取值：区间下限（市场法中位数）\nPS_REC = PRICE_REC / TOTAL_SHARES                                # 每股价格\nNEW_SHARES = INVEST / PS_REC                                     # POST_MONEY_REC / NP_ATTR[\"2025\"],\n    \"投前/2025扣非归母\": PRICE_REC / BRIDGE[\"2025\"][\"扣非归母\"],\n    \"投后/2025扣非归母\": POST_MONEY_REC / BRIDGE[\"2025\"][\"扣非归母\"],\n    \"投前/2026承诺\": PRICE_REC / \"投后EV/2025EBITDA\": (POST_MONEY_REC + NET_DEBT_MKT) / EBITDA_2025_PARENT,\n}\n# 业绩承诺覆盖\nCOMMIT_G26_IMPLIED = (COMMIT[\"2026\"] / BRIDGE[\"2025\"][\"扣非归母\"] - 1) * 100\nH1_KF = DCF 计算（严格按指引32）\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\ndef run_dcf(wacc, g, beta=None, ret_detail=False):\n    \"\"\"按指引公式计算 DCF；beta 仅用于冲突影响量化披露。\"\"\"\n    if \"可支配货币资金\": free_cash, \"净负债\": net_debt, \"股权价值\": eq,\n           \"每股价值\": eq / TOTAL_SHARES}\n    return out\n\nDCF = run_dcf(None, G_PERP)\nWACC, EQ_DCF = DCF[\"WACC\"], DCF[\"股权价值\"]\n#
